subject: How to save qplot result in a list?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: How to save qplot result in a list?
parts:
I want to plot three figures and than put them side by side with
arrange(). Somehow, the three figures are the same. Is it because the
elements in the list are all the same? How to save qplot results in a
list?

library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
x=1:10
y=1:10

p=lapply(
#(-10:10)/10
-1:1
, function(k) {
qplot(x,y*k)
}
)

do.call(
arrange
, p
)

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: How to save qplot result in a list?
parts:
It's because the scoping rules for qplot when data isn't supplied are
complex and don't always do what you want. It's usually best to supply
data when creating plots programmatically.

Hadley
